limitations: Native x86_64 Linux qualification only; foreign static guest builds and guest VM execution are not qualified by this checkpoint.
Production guest consumers retain their existing builder. Performance acceptance and production cutover remain open.

Editor comparison requires exact guest-owned roots, features, diagnostic locations and types, with no analyzer panics or unattributed Bazel diagnostics. Cargo also analyzes library test bodies in unselected path dependencies, so aggregate inference counts are not comparable.
Both analyzer statistics and every unselected or unattributed Cargo diagnostic are retained. The three matching guest diagnostics remain visible; this is not a claim of complete inference.
The static executable has no ELF interpreter or DT_NEEDED imports. Its optional glibc locale/timezone data reference is retained and reported.
Guest test parity includes both library and binary libtests, both integration targets, and the empty doctest inventory. Ignored cases remain ignored.
The package build disables shared cache reuse and verifies actual sandboxed compiler execution and the exact declared static runtime archive bytes.
